name: PLATO MILP Pathological Cases Benchmark
description: Benchmarks MIP solvers on 45 MILP instances that are considered slightly pathological—problems where standard solver heuristics tend to struggle due to degenerate structure, numerical difficulty, or unusual combinatorial properties. Instances range from 41 to 274,416 constraints and 13,264 to 196,788 variables. The benchmark highlights solver robustness beyond standard MIPLIB performance.
typical_sota_score: COPT (scaled mean 1.0), Optverse (1.41); XSMO solved most instances (33/45). 3-hour time limit.
reputation: Specialist benchmark for solver robustness; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Includes random row/column perturbation in preprocessing. Tests solver robustness on numerically or combinatorially difficult instances.
